    input_str = sys.stdin.readline().strip()

ONES = [0] * 17
ONES[1] = 1
for i in range(2, 17):
    ONES[i] = 10 * ONES[i - 1] + 1

def process_number(x):
    return compute_cost(x, 16)

def compute_cost(x, length):
    x = abs(x)
    if x % ONES[length] == 0:
        return (x // ONES[length]) * length
    lower = x // ONES[length]
    upper = lower + 1

    cost_option1 = lower * length + compute_cost(x - lower * ONES[length], length - 1)
    cost_option2 = upper * length + compute_cost(upper * ONES[length] - x, length - 1)
    return min(cost_option1, cost_option2)
